Airblade Charm.name: Airblade Charm
Airblade Charm.description: You can attach this charm to a weapon with a Melee range. Three times per rest, you can activate the charm and attack a target within Close range.

Arcane Cloak.description: A creature with a Spellcast trait wearing this cloak can adjust its color, texture, and size at will.

Arcane Prism.description: Position this prism in a location of your choosing and activate it. All allies within Close range of it gain a +1 bonus to their Spellcast Rolls. While activated, the prism can't be moved. Once the prism is deactivated, it can't be activated again until your next long rest.

Attune Relic.name: Attune Relic

Bag of Ficklesand.description: You can convince this small bag of sand to be much heavier or lighter with a successful [[/dr trait="presence" difficulty="10"]]. Additionally, on a successful [[/dr trait="finesse" difficulty="10"]], you can blow a bit of sand into a target's face to make them temporarily Vulnerable.

Belt of Unity.name: Belt of Unity
Belt of Unity.description: Once per session, you can spend 5 Hope to lead a Tag Team Roll with three PCs instead of two.

You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn't already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature.

Brutal: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

Box of Many Goods.description: Once per long rest, you can open this small box and roll a [[/r d12]]. On a result of 1–6, it's empty. On a result of 7–10, it contains one random common consumable. On a result of 11–12, it contains two random common consumables.

Calming Pendant.name: Calming Pendant
Calming Pendant.description: When you would mark your last Stress, roll a [[/r d6]]. On a result of 5 or higher, don't mark it.

Charging Quiver.name: Charging Quiver
Charging Quiver.description: When you succeed on an attack with an arrow stored in this quiver, gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to your current tier.

Clay Companion.description: When you sculpt this ball of clay into a clay animal companion, it behaves as that animal. For example, a clay spider can spin clay webs, while a clay bird can fly. OwjK2TqOizTiRGxD.name: Control Relic
OwjK2TqOizTiRGxD.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Finesse.

Dual Flask.description: This flask can hold two different liquids. You can swap between them by flipping a small switch on the flask's side.

Elusive Amulet.name: Elusive Amulet
Elusive Amulet.description: Once per long rest, you can activate this amulet to become Hidden until you move. While Hidden in this way, you remain unseen even if an adversary moves to where they would normally see you.

YBkYjxU0Vn5JEsMK.description: You are Hidden until you move. While Hidden in this way, you remain unseen even if an adversary moves to where they would normally see you.

Empty Chest.description: This magical chest appears empty. When you speak a specific trigger word or action and open the chest, you can see the items stored within it.

Enlighten Relic.name: Enlighten Relic
Enlighten Relic.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Knowledge. You can only carry one relic.

aWOGlmqC9l86GlFV.name: Enlighten Relic
aWOGlmqC9l86GlFV.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Knowledge.

Flickerfly Pendant.description: While you carry this pendant, your weapons with a Melee range that deal physical damage have a gossamer sheen and can attack targets within Very Close range.

Gecko Gloves.name: Gecko Gloves
Gecko Gloves.description: You can climb up vertical surfaces and across ceilings.

Gem of Alacrity.name: Gem of Alacrity
Gem of Alacrity.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Agility when making an attack with that weapon.

Gem of Audacity.name: Gem of Audacity
Gem of Audacity.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Presence when making an attack with that weapon.

Gem of Insight.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Instinct when making an attack with that weapon.

Gem of Might.name: Gem of Might
Gem of Might.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Strength when making an attack with that weapon.

Gem of Precision.name: Gem of Precision
Gem of Precision.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Finesse when making an attack with that weapon.

Gem of Sagacity.name: Gem of Sagacity
Gem of Sagacity.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Knowledge when making an attack with that weapon.

Glamour Stone.name: Glamour Stone
Glamour Stone.description: Activate this pebble-sized stone to memorize the appearance of someone you can see. Spend a Hope to magically recreate this guise on yourself as an illusion.

K5SB6tfuDkdVaQYe.name: Glamour Stone
K5SB6tfuDkdVaQYe.description: Activate this pebble-sized stone to memorize the appearance of someone you can see. Spend a Hope to magically recreate this guise on yourself as an illusion.

Glider.name: Glider
Glider.description: While falling, you can mark a Stress to deploy this small parachute and glide safely to the ground.

Greatstone.name: Greatstone
Greatstone.description:
You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn't already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature.

Powerful: On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

Homing Compasses.name: Homing Compasses
Homing Compasses.description: These two compasses point toward each other no matter how far apart they are.

Honing Relic.name: Honing Relic
Honing Relic.description: You gain a +1 bonus to an Experience of your choice. You can only carry one relic.

Hopekeeper Locket.name: Hopekeeper Locket
Hopekeeper Locket.description:
During a long rest, if you have 6 Hope, you can spend a Hope to imbue this locket with your bountiful resolve.

When you have 0 Hope, you can use the locket to immediately gain a Hope. The locket must be re-imbued before it can be used this way again.

Infinite Bag.name: Infinite Bag
Infinite Bag.description: When you store items in this bag, they are kept in a pocket dimension that never runs out of space. You can retrieve an item at any time.

Lakestrider Boots.name: Lakestrider Boots
Lakestrider Boots.description: You can walk on the surface of water as if it were soft ground.

Lorekeeper.name: Lorekeeper
Lorekeeper.description: You can store the name and details of up to three hostile creatures inside this book. You gain a +1 bonus to action rolls against those creatures.

Manacles.name: Manacles
Manacles.description: This pair of locking cuffs comes with a key.

Minor Health Potion Recipe.name: Minor Health Potion Recipe
Minor Health Potion Recipe.description: As a downtime move, you can use a vial of blood to craft a Minor Health Potion.

Minor Stamina Potion Recipe.name: Minor Stamina Potion Recipe
Minor Stamina Potion Recipe.description: As a downtime move, you can use the bone of a creature to craft a Minor Stamina Potion.

Mythic Dust Recipe.name: Mythic Dust Recipe
Mythic Dust Recipe.description: As a downtime move, you can use a handful of fine gold dust to craft Mythic Dust.

Phoenix Feather.name: Phoenix Feather
Phoenix Feather.description: If you have at least one Phoenix Feather on you when you fall unconscious, you gain a +1 bonus to the roll you make to determine whether you gain a scar.

Piercing Arrows.name: Piercing Arrows
Piercing Arrows.description: Three times per rest when you succeed on an attack with one of these arrows, you can add your Proficiency to the damage roll.

lRfqfbwlfxzPbE6U.name: Piercing Arrows
lRfqfbwlfxzPbE6U.description: Add your Proficiency to the damage roll of this attack.

Piper Whistle.description: This handcrafted whistle has a distinctive sound. When you blow this whistle, its piercing tone can be heard within a 1-mile radius.

Portal Seed.name: Portal Seed
Portal Seed.description: You can plant this seed in the ground to grow a portal in that spot. The portal is ready to use in 24 hours. You can use this portal to travel to any other location where you planted a portal seed. A portal can be destroyed by dealing any amount of magic damage to it.

Premium Bedroll.name: Premium Bedroll
Premium Bedroll.description: During downtime, you automatically clear a Stress.

Ring of Resistance.name: Ring of Resistance
Ring of Resistance.description: Once per long rest, you can activate this ring after a successful attack against you to halve the damage.

Sj7uGf560T7u4rlX.name: Ring of Resistance
Sj7uGf560T7u4rlX.description: Once per long rest, you can activate this ring after a successful attack against you to halve the damage.

Ring of Silence.description: Spend a Hope to activate this ring. Your footsteps are silent until your next rest.

9JSLRu7amQ4iuIO7.name: Ring of Silence
9JSLRu7amQ4iuIO7.description: Your footsteps are silent until your next rest.

Ring of Unbreakable Resolve.description: Once per session, when the GM spends a Fear, you can spend 4 Hope to cancel the effects of that spent Fear.

Shard of Memory.name: Shard of Memory
Shard of Memory.description: Once per long rest, you can spend 2 Hope to recall a domain card from your vault instead of paying its Recall Cost.

Skeleton Key.name: Skeleton Key
Skeleton Key.description: When you use this key to open a locked door, you gain advantage on the Finesse Roll.

Speaking Orbs.name: Speaking Orbs
Speaking Orbs.description: This pair of orbs allows any creatures holding them to communicate with each other across any distance.

Stride Relic.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Agility. You can only carry one relic.

7lHIbMyCDonSxSZf.name: Stride Relic
7lHIbMyCDonSxSZf.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Agility.

Suspended Rod.name: Suspended Rod
Suspended Rod.description: This flat rod is inscribed with runes. When you activate the rod, it is immediately suspended in place. Until the rod is deactivated, it can't move, doesn't abide by the rules of gravity, and remains in place.

Valorstone.name: Valorstone
Valorstone.description:
You can attach this stone to armor that doesn't already have a feature. The armor gains the following feature.

Resilient: Before you mark your last Armor Slot, roll a d6. On a result of 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

Vial of Darksmoke Recipe.name: Vial of Darksmoke Recipe
Vial of Darksmoke Recipe.description: As a downtime move, you can mark a Stress to craft a Vial of Darksmoke.

Woven Net.name: Woven Net
Woven Net.description: You can make a Finesse Roll using this net to trap a small creature. A trapped target can break free with a successful Attack Roll (16).

Alistair's Torch.name: Alistair's Torch
Alistair's Torch.description: You can light this magic torch at will. The flame's light fills a much larger space than it should, enough to illuminate a cave bright as day.

Augur's Relic.name: Augur's Relic
Augur's Relic.description: Once per long rest, you can activate your Hope feature without spending Hope. You can carry only one relic.

Ball Bearings.name: Ball Bearings
Ball Bearings.description: This pouch contains perfectly smooth metal spheres.

Blackwing Quill.name: Blackwing Quill
Blackwing Quill.description: This writing quill never runs out of ink or needs to be sharpened.

Boots of Supple Mystique.name: Boots of Supple Mystique
Boots of Supple Mystique.description: While wearing these boots, you don't leave tracks or footprints.

Box of Dragon Dust.name: Box of Dragon Dust
Box of Dragon Dust.description: This snuffbox is filled with combustible powder.

Brooch.name: Brooch
Brooch.description: On a successful weapon attack, you can knock your target back up to Close range from their location.

Caltrops.name: Caltrops
Caltrops.description: You can spread these caltrops in a Very Close area around you. A creature hastening through that area must mark a Stress.

Cheater's Coin.name: Cheater's Coin
Cheater's Coin.description: When you flip this coin, you can spend a Hope to determine which side it lands on.

Collapsible Pole.name: Collapsible Pole
Collapsible Pole.description: You can break down this 18-foot pole into six interlinked 3-foot segments.

Collar of Ascendancy.name: Collar of Ascendancy
Collar of Ascendancy.description: An animal who wears this collar gains the ability to speak and understand common speech.

Communion Relic.name: Communion Relic
Communion Relic.description: Once per rest, you can spend a Hope to use an ally's Experience as if it were your own. You can carry only one relic.

Crucible Frames.name: Crucible Frames
Crucible Frames.description: These eyeglasses reveal weak points in objects and creatures. Three times per rest, you can spend a Hope to gain advantage on an attack roll.

Dagginae's Obsidian Slate.name: Dagginae's Obsidian Slate
Dagginae's Obsidian Slate.description: This wafer-thin sheet of volcanic glass is used by archivists to keep notes. Any information etched onto its surface disappears but can be recalled via a command you set.

Eclipse Coin.name: Eclipse Coin
Eclipse Coin.description: Once per rest, [[/r 1d2]]{flip a coin.} On heads, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls until your next successful attack. On tails, you gain +1 to your Evasion until an attack fails against you.

1thJk2e2snAmyvq3.name: Heads
1thJk2e2snAmyvq3.description: +1 bonus to attack rolls until your next successful attack.

oGs7nvr3uO52GVTI.name: Tails
oGs7nvr3uO52GVTI.description: +1 to your Evasion until an attack fails against you.

Elven Spyglass.name: Elven Spyglass
Elven Spyglass.description: You can use this spyglass to magnify your vision a hundredfold.

Enchanter's Loupe.name: Enchanter's Loupe
Enchanter's Loupe.description: You can use this loupe to see through illusions and enchantments.

Escher's Mirrorball.name: Escher's Mirrorball
Escher's Mirrorball.description: Once per long rest, you can command this fist-sized silver orb to capture an omnidirectional image of its surroundings on its surface. This image lasts until your next long rest.

V5vAUbBIXfaUmMKi.name: Captured Image
V5vAUbBIXfaUmMKi.description: This image lasts until your next long rest.

Force Disc.name: Force Disc
Force Disc.description: This shimmering two-dimensional disc of magical force has a 4-foot diameter and is magically tethered to a pebble. The disc always floats 3 feet north of, and at the same elevation as, the pebble. The pebble has a mass equal to one-hundredth of the total mass carried by the disc.

Furball Bag.name: Furball Bag
Furball Bag.description: Once per rest, you can produce [[/r 2d20]] harmless, cat-sized fur creatures of indeterminate origin and species from this bag.

Gadiman's Backpack.name: Gadiman's Backpack
Gadiman's Backpack.description: Once per rest, you can spend a Hope to conjure a mundane item up to a cubic foot in size inside this satchel.

Ghoulskin Gloves.name: Ghoulskin Gloves
Ghoulskin Gloves.description: When you attack with a physical weapon while wearing these gloves, the damage is considered both physical and magic.

Gloves of Alacrity.name: Gloves of Alacrity
Gloves of Alacrity.description: When you would mark a Stress to reload a weapon, you don't mark it.

Gourmet Granules.name: Gourmet Granules
Gourmet Granules.description: This savory powder makes any food it's sprinkled on delicious and healthy, no matter how bland or rotten it is.

Grapnel.name: Grapnel
Grapnel.description: You gain advantage on action rolls to climb sheer surfaces.

GdW5jIrTba4dr4Rv.name: Grapnel
GdW5jIrTba4dr4Rv.description: You gain advantage on action rolls to climb sheer surfaces.

Gravewarden's Bell.description: This bell rings when a ghost or undead creature moves within Far range of it.

Hero's Helm.name: Hero's Helm
Hero's Helm.description: When you critically succeed on an attack, all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

Hollowbark Horn.name: Hollowbark Horn
Hollowbark Horn.description: You can blow this horn to summon a small woodland creature to perform a simple task.

Insomniac's Periapt.name: Insomniac's Periapt
Insomniac's Periapt.description: When you take a rest without clearing Hit Points or Stress, you gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls until your next rest.

lQGyhpLsjSIa2IFI.name: Insomniac
lQGyhpLsjSIa2IFI.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls until your next rest.

Iron Dagger Pendant.name: Iron Dagger Pendant
Iron Dagger Pendant.description: Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to tell the pendant a creature's name. The pendant gently pulls you toward that creature's current location until your next long rest.

s4bAygaEXKL5YTRQ.name: Iron Dagger Pendant
s4bAygaEXKL5YTRQ.description: The pendant gently pulls you toward that creature's current location until your next long rest.

Iron Veil.name: Iron Veil
Iron Veil.description: This chain-link head covering renders the wearer invisible to fey creatures.

Kingfisher's Net.name: Kingfisher's Net
Kingfisher's Net.description: Once per long rest, you can use this net to scoop one live fish out of any amount of water, no matter how unlikely it is for that water to have fish in it.

Knockback Bracelets.name: Knockback Bracelets
Knockback Bracelets.description: On a successful weapon attack, you can knock your target back up to Close range from their location.

Loaded Dice.name: Loaded Dice
Loaded Dice.description: You can choose what result this set of weighted dice rolls with a successful Finesse Roll (14). If you roll with Fear, anyone watching knows the dice are loaded.

Mandragorian Torch.name: Mandragorian Torch
Mandragorian Torch.description: This torch gives off light only the bearer can see.

Map of Revelation.name: Map of Revelation
Map of Revelation.description: You can attune this map to one creature at a time. The map always shows the attuned creature's location.

Molepaw Mittens.name: Molepaw Mittens
Molepaw Mittens.description: Spend a Hope to swim through earth as if it were water for the next 10 minutes.

zhPgjJuW4MWl7Lb9.name: Molepaw Mittens
zhPgjJuW4MWl7Lb9.description: You can swim through earth as if it were water for the next 10 minutes.

Namer's Oracle.name: Namer's Oracle
Namer's Oracle.description: Once per session, you can roll this set of runic dice to reveal the full name of the last person you touched.

Nighthawker's Ring.name: Nighthawker's Ring
Nighthawker's Ring.description: Spend a Hope to activate the gemstone in this ring until the end of the scene. While active, the gemstone changes color to indicate the wearer's proximity to hidden treasure: warm colors for near, cool colors for far.

EUPb3chDFCISikV4.name: Nighthawker's Ring
EUPb3chDFCISikV4.description: While active, the gemstone changes color to indicate the wearer's proximity to hidden treasure: warm colors for near, cool colors for far.

Paragon's Chain.name: Paragon's Chain
Paragon's Chain.description:
As a downtime move, you can meditate on an ideal or principle you hold dear and focus your will into this chain.

Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to roll a d20 as your Hope Die for rolls that directly align with that principle.

Phobophage's Circlet.name: Phobophage's Circlet
Phobophage's Circlet.description: When the GM spends a Fear, roll a d4. Once per scene on a result of 4, you clear a Stress.

Portal Frames.name: Portal Frames
Portal Frames.description: This pair of small ornate frames, one red and one blue, are connected. Anything that passes into one exits from the other.

Quillshawl.name: Quillshawl
Quillshawl.description: If an adversary attacks you within Melee range, they must succeed on a Reaction Roll (12) or mark a Hit Point.

Reliquary of the Sightless Saint.name: Reliquary of the Sightless Saint
Reliquary of the Sightless Saint.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Hope Die when you make the Risk It All death move.

Returning Ring.name: Returning Ring
Returning Ring.description: When you throw your primary weapon while wearing this ring, the weapon appears in your hand immediately after the attack.

Rings of Alliance.name: Rings of Alliance
Rings of Alliance.description: Two creatures can wear this pair of rose gold rings. Once per session, you can initiate a Tag Team Roll with whoever is wearing the other ring without spending Hope or counting against your session limit for Tag Team Rolls.

Rings of Camaraderie.name: Rings of Camaraderie
Rings of Camaraderie.description: Two creatures can wear this pair of wooden rings. You can mark the Stress of whoever is wearing the other ring (with their permission) as if it were your own.

Rings of Friendship.name: Rings of Friendship
Rings of Friendship.description: Two creatures can wear this pair of rings shaped like coiled snakes. You can spend the Hope of whoever is wearing the other ring (with their permission) as if it were your own.

Self-Tying Rope.name: Self-Tying Rope
Self-Tying Rope.description: You can command this rope to tie or untie itself.

Silee's Folding Knife.name: Silee's Folding Knife
Silee's Folding Knife.description: This 3-inch blade has an edge that easily cuts through anything except the handle it's stored in.

Sorcerer's Hat.name: Sorcerer's Hat
Sorcerer's Hat.description: This conical blue hat is covered in silver stars. Once per rest, you can cast a spell from your vault with a Recall Cost equal to or less than your tier. This doesn't work for permanently vaulted cards.

Soul-Twin Circlets.name: Soul-Twin Circlets
Soul-Twin Circlets.description: Two creatures can wear this pair of circlets. You can spend a Hope to switch places with whoever is wearing the other circlet.

Temporal Sanctuary.name: Temporal Sanctuary
Temporal Sanctuary.description: A PC who takes a rest in the temporal sanctuary can choose an additional downtime move.

K1ZreKqxSLXvANm5.name: Temporal Sanctuary
K1ZreKqxSLXvANm5.description: A PC who takes a rest in the temporal sanctuary can choose an additional downtime move.

Thief's Compass.name: Thief's Compass
Thief's Compass.description: This compass points the way toward the nearest exit while indoors and the closest entrance while outdoors.

Timekeeper's Pendant.name: Timekeeper's Pendant
Timekeeper's Pendant.description: You can choose an additional downtime move each rest.

RaFL9RF6M2Oa1Mc0.name: Timekeeper's Pendant
RaFL9RF6M2Oa1Mc0.description: You can choose an additional downtime move each rest.

Titan's Girdle.name: Titan's Girdle
Titan's Girdle.description: Once per scene, you can activate this girdle to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next attack.

YQFUsFB2APojHKbh.name: Active Girdle
YQFUsFB2APojHKbh.description: +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next attack.

Traveler's Bell.name: Traveler's Bell
Traveler's Bell.description: Once per long rest, you can ring this bell to magically open the shortest safe path through rough terrain for 1 hour.

Two-Faced Aegis Brooch.name: Two-Faced Aegis Brooch
Two-Faced Aegis Brooch.description: Once per rest, [[/r 1d2]]{flip a coin}. On heads, you become immune to the next physical damage you take. On tails, you become immune to the next magic damage you take.

v4B2AXAw5ipJ3KG6.name: Heads
v4B2AXAw5ipJ3KG6.description: On heads, you become immune to the next physical damage you take.

pxrbpDOlTozFmTnr.name: Tails
pxrbpDOlTozFmTnr.description: On tails, you become immune to the next magic damage you take.

Warp Pendant.name: Warp Pendant
Warp Pendant.description: Once per rest, mark a Stress to teleport to a location you can clearly see.

Whisperstep Anklet.name: Whisperstep Anklet
Whisperstep Anklet.description: This anklet makes your steps silent as long as you don't move faster than walking speed.

Wildrider's Saddle.name: Wildrider's Saddle
Wildrider's Saddle.description: This saddle grants any animal it's strapped onto the ability to understand their rider's commands.

Windup Toy.name: Windup Toy
Windup Toy.description: This small mechanical device is shaped like a strixwolf pup and can be programmed to perform simple tricks.

Zephyr's Jar.name: Zephyr's Jar
Zephyr's Jar.description: You can open this empty jar during inclement weather to capture the storm and leave behind clear skies. The storm remains inside until unleashed by reopening the jar.
